vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek fixing something.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek sighs. "I need some space. A corner nobody needs me in. Is that okay?" (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "Good eyes. Keep watching."
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek was watching. Now they know American Hazelnut too.
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek was watching. Now they know Muscadine Grapes too.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek sets out for the humming in the grass. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."
You catch fragments by the fire — Nora telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about George. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 50s, with a scarred cheek has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The humming in the grass — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nora breathes "Say that again — slower." the woman in her 40s says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
🥩 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is back with strange meat: unknown flesh in the pantry. "Test it cautiously before anyone eats."
🥩 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is back empty-handed. "Nothing worth hauling out there."
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
👀 Someone mentioned Denver and the man in his 50s, with a scarred cheek answered to it a beat late — like responding to a name that isn't quite yours.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek).
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling Katarina about Priya. The retelling is already better than the event.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek showed Nikolai the Blackberry — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling Priya about Ethan. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.

🔥 The fire settles. Sarawut has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nora says quietly "So it bleeds." the man in his 50s, with a scarred cheek asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about stripes resolving out of the bamboo. Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched."
You catch fragments by the fire — Minh telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about themself. The retelling is already better than the event.
🛡️ Sandra, Nora, Sarawut, Katarina and Nikos met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Sandra, Nora, Sarawut, Nikos are hurt.
🛡️ Lucas, Nikos and Nikolai met them at the door — 3 put down. Nikos, Nikolai are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Sarawut, Lucas and Nikos met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Sarawut, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lucas, Nikos and Priya met them at the door — 3 put down. Lucas, Nikos, Priya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lucas, Nikos, Priya and Thabo met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Nikos, Priya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Old Croaker falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Old Croaker!
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
